snippet.title: Dystopicon Launch Date Trailer [CENSORED] - Out July 27 on Steam
snippet.description:
Launching July 27 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3713750/Dystopicon/

An uncomfortable dystopian time-management game where your job is watching TV to earn money and buy services to survive after robots replace humans at work. Choose to be a good citizen or a rebel. But beware! Curiosity has a price in this satirical life simulator.
